menu_options.manual: Advanced: enter an existing device ID and PIN

register.title: CEB Mauritius
register.description: Enter the email registered on the MoKouran app, choose a 4-digit PIN for Home Assistant (can differ from your phone's), and your contract account number (on your bill). CEB will email you a one-time code.

activate.title: Activate Home Assistant on your CEB account
activate.description: Enter the one-time code CEB just emailed you.

manual.title: CEB Mauritius (advanced)
manual.description: Enter an existing MoKouran device ID and PIN, plus the contract account number.

error.bad_code: The code was rejected. Check the emailed code and try again.
error.user_not_found: No MoKouran app user for that email. Use the email registered in the MoKouran app (not necessarily your CEB bill email).
